description: A calibration tool for external CV gear. It sends a series of voltages out, measures the pitch that comes back, and builds a map that corrects the pitch voltages you send through it afterwards

params.text: Runs the calibration, stepping through the voltages and recording the pitch each one produced

inputs.text: The signal coming back from the device, whose pitch is measured
A pitch voltage to be corrected by the map built during calibration

outputs.text: The voltage sent out to the device being calibrated
The pitch voltage from the input, corrected by the map built during calibration

notes: the frequency detector reads from 30Hz to 5000Hz, and a sine or a triangle wave is read more reliably than a brighter waveform.
a lamp lights while a map is held in memory, and the map is kept with the patch and with a saved preset.
voltages are clipped to -20V either way; a range wider than that raises an error and stops the calibration.
menu: RANGES — sets the span the calibration steps through: Tuning range C0 to C8, C1 to C7, C2 to C6, C1 to C6, C1 to C5, C0 to C5 or C0 to C4
RANGES — sets the span the calibration steps through, printed as tuning ranges: C0 to C8, C1 to C7, C2 to C6, C1 to C6, C1 to C5, C0 to C5 or C0 to C4
Use OCTAVE Mapping (faster) — measures one point per octave
Use SEMITONES Mapping — measures every semitone, which takes longer than measuring one point per octave
